base: Stylized semi-realistic 3D animated character portrait of the woman in the reference photo, keeping her real face shape, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone and her own hairstyle and hair colour. Only her head and hair, floating, no neck or shoulders, perfectly front-facing, head upright and centred. Square 1:1 image, fully transparent background (PNG with alpha). Hair reaches near the edges of the square; eyes sit at 46% of the image height, the mouth at 65%, the chin at about 76%. Soft studio lighting, high detail, warm skin, gentle closed-mouth smile, eyes looking straight at the viewer.
